# Ninai

Ninai is a permissioned, source-backed memory layer for AI tools. Its local engine is available; its hosted cross-provider beta is under development.

## Canonical pages
- Home: https://ninai.io/
- Install: https://ninai.io/install/
- Local engine: https://ninai.io/local/
- Compatibility: https://ninai.io/compatibility/
- Research: https://ninai.io/research/
- Privacy: https://ninai.io/privacy/

## Core product facts
- The MVP stores memory in a local SQLite database.
- It exposes memory through MCP.
- Recall is filtered by explicit per-client scopes.
- Returned context packets include provenance and a token budget.
- The full vault stays local, but released context is sent to the selected AI provider.
- Automatic capture currently targets Claude Code PostToolUse hooks.
- Hosted OpenAI/Anthropic interoperability is not yet release-tested or generally available.
- MCP does not give Ninai silent access to all ChatGPT or Claude conversations.
- Local vaults are never uploaded or synchronized automatically.
- The MVP is not production encrypted or independently audited.
